items.title: Trains cancelled and road warnings as Scotland prepares for Storm Boelo
items.description: Heavy rain and strong winds are expected during the second named storm to hit in two days, with gusts of up to 80mph forecast.

items.title: Storm Boelo to bring severe gales and heavy rain into Sunday
items.description: An amber weather warning has been issued for much of Scotland, parts of Northern Ireland and northern England, as Storm Boelo approaches.

items.title: Weather warnings in place ahead of Storm Boelo
items.description: The amber Met Office alert for counties Antrim and Londonderry lasts from 21:00 BST on Saturday until 21:00 GMT on Sunday.

items.title: EU moves to loosen rules on pesticide use as experts sound the alarm
items.description: The European Union wants to relax rules for pesticides, saying it will be easier for farmers to adopt more environmentally friendly options. But health and environmental experts say the risks are far too great.

sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Turkey's new deal on Mediterranean maritime boundaries with Libya is exacerbating issues with Greece and the EU
items.description: Turkey and Libya plan to redraw maritime boundaries in the Mediterranean as part of a new economic corridor. This has sparked strong protests from Greece, and has also drawn the European Union into the conflict.
